description: Checks that the spec-business skill writes an R-table spec with Given/When/Then criteria and labels unknowns.

cases.query: Write a business spec for a bakery that sells sourdough bread to offices in one city.
expected: Writes spec.md with R rows for market, customers, value proposition, and revenue, each with a Given/When/Then criterion, and a Non-goals heading
labels unknown market size UNKNOWN or ASSUMED
writes no design or API files.
